description: This file is a shell script containing tests for various corner cases of 'git archive', including handling of empty trees, different archive formats (tar, zip), large files, long paths, and platform-specific behaviors.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory and sets up cleanup after test.

methods.name: check_dir
methods.description: Checks that a directory contains exactly the specified set of paths.

methods.name: build_tree
methods.description: Generates a tree of blobs with long paths for testing.
